Synopsis: Guard nervously awaiting the start of a battle. Player may have met previously, when her legs were immobilised by a potion. Cluster Contexts: - DEN_AttackOnDen_Tiefling005.json: The scene is a tense pre‑battle moment: a nervous guard (Pandirna) is waiting for a fight to begin while nearby forces and preparations hum off‑screen. The player and Pandirna may have a brief shared history — earlier she had her legs immobilised by a potion, so the two might recognize one another and that familiarity affects tone. This exchange sits against the wider backdrop of recent attacks on the Druid Grove/goblin den (Halsin, scouts, and other parties are involved elsewhere), so stakes and allegiances are already set by prior encounters. The player’s line can be earnest encouragement or a flippant provocation depending on that history and on earlier choices about who was spared or how the fighting has been handled. - FOR_GoblinAmbush_Warning.json: Goblin warrior standing guard in the abandoned village - she's eager for a fight and slightly let down if we talk our way past. - FOR_GnomeGoblin6.json: A goblin tracker stands guard as their leader torments a captive. If the player interferes, they turn hostile (unless the player is a drow - in this case the goblins are servile and afraid). - FOR_GnomeGoblin4.json: A goblin tracker stands guard as their leader torments a captive. If the player interferes, they turn hostile (unless the player is a drow - in this case the goblins are servile and afraid). - FOR_GoblinAmbush.json: This dialogue triggers when players enter a village being guarded by goblins. context: Pandirna is a nervous guard waiting for a fight to start; nearby forces and preparations are active off‑screen and the wider attack on the den/Druid Grove is already underway. The player may have met her before—earlier her legs were immobilised by a potion—so there can be a touch of familiarity that changes the tone of the exchange. Depending on the player’s past choices and attitude, lines can be sincere encouragement or teasing provocation. Goblin forces are the likely enemy here and will be hostile unless parley succeeds (with some dialog outcomes differing if the player is a drow).
